LICENCE & PERMITS

Fishing licence for Nevada

Anglers aged 12 or older need a fishing licence. A person who helps another angler also needs a licence.

  • 1 day$18 USD
  • 1 additional consecutive day$7 USD
  • 1 year$80 USD
  • 1 year$15 USD
